req.title: Retrieve player by squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber} with the player wearing that squad number.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /players/squadNumber/{squadNumber}. I design tests across EP (valid squad number returns correct player), NEG (non-existent squad number returns 404, non-integer path returns 422), BVA (boundary squad numbers 1 and 26 — the lowest and highest pre-loaded values, and 0 and 27 just outside the populated range), DT (all response fields validated exactly), and STC (player exists vs does not exist). Each test asserts exact HTTP status codes and exact payload field values to maximise mutation kill rate against operator-flip, constant-bump, and boolean-negation mutations.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players with squad numbers 1-26
Squad number 10 belongs to Kabir Mary Reddy
expected: Response body contains all fields matching the pre-loaded row for squad number 10
trace: R-PLAYER-004: system shall respond with the player wearing that squad number
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

def test_get_player_by_squad_number_existing_mid_range():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/squadnumber/10')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert body['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert body['dateOfBirth'] == '1910-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'
    assert body['squadNumber'] == 10
    assert body['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert body['abbrPosition'] == 'DM'
    assert body['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert body['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert body['starting11'] == False
